base.description: Design tokens, cn() helper and theme hook. Installed by `init`.

button.description: Raised key that sinks when pressed. Variants: default, glow, ghost, inset, danger.

card.description: Raised or inset surface with a staggered entrance.

switch.description: Tactile switch that lights up when on: glowing rim, halo and LED.

dot-icon.description: Dot-matrix canvas icon that morphs between glyphs through particles.

theme-switch.description: The signature light/dark switch with sun-to-moon particle morph and circular reveal. Also exports <ThemeScript /> for flash-free SSR.

input.description: Recessed text field with icon and trailing slots.

status-lamp.description: Glowing LED whose breathing speeds up with severity.

badge.description: Status pill with a glowing dot.

segmented.description: Segmented control with a spring-loaded thumb.

sparkline.description: Self-drawing sparkline in the theme glow.

stat.description: KPI tile with counter, delta chip and sparkline.

dot-chart.description: Dot-matrix bar chart with staggered pop-in.

table.description: Table whose rows are recessed strips that slide on hover.

toast.description: toast() / toast.success / toast.promise from anywhere; <Toaster /> with actions, descriptions, positions and swipe to dismiss.

nav.description: Recessed sidebar rail with rising active item and LED.

avatar.description: Raised round avatar with initials or image.

scroll-area.description: Scroll container with edge fades and the tactile scrollbar.

textarea.description: Recessed multi-line field with auto-grow and character counter.

checkbox.description: Recessed box with a glowing key that pops in; supports indeterminate.

radio-group.description: Radio wells with a springing glow bead and arrow-key navigation.

slider.description: Dot-track slider with a glowing knob and value bubble. Also exports RangeSlider (two thumbs).

tabs.description: Tabs in a recessed rail with a springing thumb.

accordion.description: Plates that sink into the page when opened.

select.description: Raised trigger with a floating listbox, typeahead and keyboard support.

dialog.description: Modal that rises out of a blurred page; focus trapped.

sheet.description: Floating side panel that springs in from an edge.

popover.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger.

tooltip.description: Raised label on hover and focus.

dropdown-menu.description: Menu with items, labels, separators and checkbox items.

command.description: Ctrl/Cmd+K command palette with fuzzy search.

alert.description: Recessed message well with a status LED.

spinner.description: Ring of dots with a glowing comet.

breadcrumb.description: Monospace path with a raised current-page chip.

pagination.description: Page keys in a recessed rail.

error-boundary.description: Safety net: a failing part shows a retry panel instead of breaking the page.

toggle.description: A key that stays down: sinks, glows and lights a corner LED when pressed.

toggle-group.description: Keys in a recessed rail, single or multiple selection, arrow-key navigation.

chip.description: Compact filter or tag pill. Selectable (sinks, dot lights up) and removable.

knob.description: Rotary dial with a lit dot ring. Drag, scroll or use the arrow keys.

copy-button.description: Copies to the clipboard; the icon swaps to a check that draws itself in.

number-input.description: Stepper with a dot-matrix value between two keys. Hold to repeat, type, or use arrows.

otp-input.description: One-time code wells with auto-advance, paste and SMS autofill.

password-input.description: Password field with a reveal key and a dot strength meter.

combobox.description: Searchable select with match highlighting and full keyboard control.

calendar.description: Month grid date picker, single day or a range, with native-style keyboard navigation.

file-drop.description: Drop zone with a dot border that lights up and lifts while dragging.

rating.description: Rating built from dot-matrix stars. Hover preview, keyboard support.

avatar-group.description: Overlapping avatars that lift on hover, with a +N chip.

empty-state.description: Empty list placeholder: dot glyph in a well, text and an action.

heatmap.description: Dot-matrix heatmap (e.g. a year of activity). Dot size and glow follow the value.

bar-list.description: Ranked list with dot bars that grow in, for top pages or referrers.

timeline.description: Activity feed on a dotted rail with status LEDs.

progress-ring.description: Circular dot progress around a recessed dial.

progress.description: Linear dot progress, determinate or an indeterminate comet.

steps.description: Step indicator for multi-step flows, horizontal or vertical.

alert-dialog.description: Confirmation dialog that waits for an answer: no backdrop close, Cancel focused first, async actions with a spinner.

aspect-ratio.description: Keeps media at a fixed ratio, optionally in an inset or raised frame.

button-group.description: Joins buttons into one raised strip with engraved separators.

carousel.description: Swipeable scroll-snap carousel with raised arrows, dot indicators, keyboard and autoplay.

chart.description: Area, line, bar and donut charts in plain SVG with tooltips, keyboard navigation and colour-blind-safe slots.

collapsible.description: Show/hide a section with an animated height.

context-menu.description: Right-click / long-press menu at the pointer, also opens with Shift+F10.

data-table.description: Table with sorting, search, row selection, pagination and an optional one-level tree (child rows fold under their parent).

date-picker.description: Trigger that opens the calendar in a popover. Single day or a range.

drawer.description: Bottom drawer for phones that follows your finger and dismisses on swipe down.

field.description: Form field wiring: label, control, description and error get ids and aria attributes automatically.

hover-card.description: Rich preview card on hover or keyboard focus.

input-group.description: Recessed field holding an input with icon, text and button addons.

item.description: List row with media, title, description and actions.

menubar.description: Desktop-app menu bar (File, Edit, View) with hover switching and arrow keys.

native-select.description: A real <select> styled as a raised key; best on phones.

navigation-menu.description: Site navigation with dropdown link panels (mega menu).

resizable.description: Split panels with draggable, keyboard-accessible dividers.

sidebar.description: App sidebar that collapses to icons (Ctrl/Cmd+B) and becomes an off-canvas panel on phones.
